ModMetaData.name: Deep Colony
ModMetaData.author: azraelgodking
ModMetaData.description:
Your colonists are more than their stats. Deep Colony adds five interlocking systems that give each colonist a real identity — and make your colony feel like it has a living history.
Three colony tabs — Perks, Legacy, and Reputation — plus full mod settings with Soft / Default / Hard presets. Soft and Default keep power systems and attitude consequences off; Hard enables the heavier set.
🌳 PERK TREES Colonists automatically unlock perks at skill levels 5, 10, 15, and 20 — better aim, faster surgery, richer harvests — with numeric tooltips and a colony-wide Perks tab. If a skill drops below the required level, that perk lapses. Perk hediffs are hidden on Health unless you turn them on in settings. Perks slow skill rust and speed up reclaiming lost levels. Optional: skill-20 capstones (on by default), branching level-15 picks, and cross-skill archetypes.
🧠 TRAUMA & THERAPY Hostile downs, violent loss, captivity, mass-casualty raids, fire, toxins, insects, and betrayal can leave lasting psychological trauma. Therapy quality scales with the counselor's Social skill, opinion, and room; doctors run one-on-one or group counseling (or right-click Counsel), and casual therapy chats still help. Recovery can leave scars — or resilience. Repeated sessions forge a confidant bond, while untreated trauma can flash back, shape combat habits, and (on Hard) turn chronic.
🎓 APPRENTICESHIP Pair a veteran with a rookie via right-click (mentor must lead by 3+ skill levels; family needs less). Apprentices earn bonus XP near their mentor; the Mentoring work type runs focused teaching sessions — boosted by a Biotech blackboard in the room. Elders (60+) slow down at labor but shine as mentors, graduating apprentices can pick up their mentor's first perk, and professional rivals push each other's XP.
👶 GENERATIONAL COLONIES Children and recruits with colonist parents or grandparents can inherit traits and passions; families develop skill traditions and colony-born children carry founder surnames. The Legacy tab tracks your founders' lines, and the Family inspect tab shows kin in Rows or Pedigree. Dying colonists leave heirlooms behind. Touch-averse colonists (reserved / averse / intolerant) and touch-starved colonists will not start a romance until they reach a named comfort tier with that person; tactile and cuddly share the same closeness meter for mood.
🏛️ LIVING FACTION REPUTATION Raids, trades, gifts, and shared-enemy kills nudge goodwill, and strong friendships and deep enmities drift over time. The Reputation tab shows a per-faction ledger; assign a personal envoy for steady goodwill, watch settlements earn epithets from your history — and, on Hard, let attitude drive trade, caravan, and raid pressure.
Requires Harmony.
